evals.name: login-screen-from-scratch
evals.prompt: I'm using @boceto/* in my docs site. Sketch a wireframe for a login screen — desktop, ~600px wide, with a top navbar reading 'MyApp', a 'Welcome back' heading, email + password inputs, a primary 'Sign In' button, and a small 'Forgot password?' link underneath. Output a single ```boceto block I can paste into a markdown file.
evals.expected_output: A fenced ```boceto block (with or without :PageName) containing element navbar, heading, two inputs, a primary-button, and at least one button or label for the forgot-password link. Must parse cleanly via @boceto/core's parse().

evals.name: edit-existing-mockup
evals.prompt:
Here's my existing Boceto mockup:

```boceto:Dashboard
element navbar 0 0 900 44 "Analytics"
element sidebar 0 44 200 460 "" items="Overview|Sales|Users"
element heading 232 70 600 32 "Overview"
element chart-bar 232 110 600 260
element table 232 380 600 120 headers="When|User|Action"
```

Add a row of three metric cards (revenue, active users, conversion rate) between the heading and the chart. Each card should show a label and a big number. Return the full updated ```boceto block.
evals.expected_output: The full original block plus 3 new card / box elements between the heading and chart-bar, with the chart and table coordinates shifted down to make room. Must parse cleanly. The new elements should be visually a row at y around 110.

evals.name: mobile-screen-with-phone-frame
evals.prompt: Sketch a mobile chat app screen for an iPhone-style mockup. 360px wide. I want: a phone-frame around everything, a status bar, a navbar reading 'Conversations', three conversation cards (one per contact: 'Sarah', 'Slack', 'GitHub') with a name and a preview line each, a floating action button at the bottom-right, and a home indicator. Output one ```boceto block.
evals.expected_output: A ```boceto block with a phone-frame as the outer container, status-bar at top, navbar below, three card elements stacked vertically, a fab in the bottom-right, and a home-indicator at the very bottom. Must parse cleanly.
